questions.stem: Which infinitive does the form "verrei" come from?
questions.explanation: The form "verrei" is the conditional form for "io" of "venire". Identifying the infinitive behind a conjugated form requires matching the stem and the person endings to the correct conjugation pattern.
questions.hint: Strip the ending and match the remaining stem to an infinitive.

questions.stem: A conjugation practice singles out the cited form at a glance. Choose the conditional: "noi finire".

options.misconception: this is the loro form of the verb, not noi
this is the tu form of the verb, not noi
this is the io form of the verb, not noi

questions.explanation: The conditional form of "finire" for "noi" is "finiremmo". The conditional uses the future stem with a different set of endings. It expresses politeness, possibility, or hypothetical results. Selecting the wrong person ending changes who performs the action.
questions.hint: Identify the subject pronoun, then apply the conditional ending for that person.
